items.context: The existing Popover component (ui/popover.tsx) already implements createPortal + fixed positioning + viewport clamping + click-outside handling. StatusChipPopover uses it successfully in the same card context. The alternative is adding portal logic directly to SnoozePopover.

options.label: Reuse existing Popover component
options.rationale: Proven pattern already used by StatusChipPopover in the same context. Gets portal, viewport clamping, and click-outside for free. Less code to maintain. Recommended because it's the established pattern and requires the least new code.

options.label: Add createPortal directly to SnoozePopover
options.rationale: More control over positioning and behavior, but duplicates logic already in the Popover component. Makes sense only if SnoozePopover needs significantly different behavior.

items.context: The action row in backlog-card.tsx:111 uses overflow-x-auto, which is the direct cause of clipping. Even with a portal fix, the overflow-x-auto may cause other UI issues (e.g., horizontal scrollbar on narrow cards). Should we also clean up this overflow?

options.label: Keep overflow-x-auto, only fix via portal
options.rationale: Minimal change, focused fix. The overflow-x-auto may serve a purpose for long action rows on narrow screens. Recommended because it limits scope to the snooze issue only.

options.label: Replace overflow-x-auto with flex-wrap
options.rationale: Prevents future clipping issues for any non-portaled content. But changes card layout and may cause visual regressions with wrapped buttons.

items.text: Root cause confirmed: SnoozePopover uses absolute positioning inside a container with overflow-x-auto (backlog-card.tsx:111). The existing Popover component (ui/popover.tsx) already solves this with createPortal to document.body + fixed positioning + viewport clamping. StatusChipPopover demonstrates this pattern working correctly in the same card context.

SnoozePopover is used in 3 positions within backlog-card.tsx: primary action row (line ~350), terminal actions row (line ~390), and standalone row (line ~401). All three will benefit from the portal fix since they share the same card container constraints.

plan_updates: Created initial plan with root cause analysis, scope definition, two approach options, testing strategy, risks, and acceptance criteria.
